cards.headline: UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara ends after 35 years
cards.summary: The UN mission for disputed Western Sahara, MINURSO, ceased operations Sunday after 35 years. The territory, once ruled by Spain, is claimed by both Morocco and the pro-independence Polisario Front. The UN has warned of security risks.
cards.why_it_matters: The end of a long-running ceasefire monitor raises the risk of renewed conflict in North Africa, a region where the US has diplomatic interests.

sources.title: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years

cards.headline: Hungary to publish names of communist-era informants
cards.summary: Hungary's new government will on Wednesday reveal the names of tens of thousands of state informants from 1945 to 1989, opening security police files in an effort to confront the past and rebuild public trust.
cards.why_it_matters: The release shows how Hungary's new government is reshaping its politics, with effects on a NATO and EU member's domestic stability.

sources.title: ‘Traitors in every family’: Hungary to unmask communist-era informants and confront past

cards.headline: Hebron governor says Israeli forces withdrew after 10-day siege
cards.summary: Hebron's governor, Khaled Dudin, said Israeli forces have pulled out of the West Bank city after a 10-day siege and that families forced from their homes can return. Nearly 5,000 people had been displaced, Al Jazeera reported.
cards.why_it_matters: The siege displaced thousands and adds to West Bank tensions that complicate US diplomacy in the region. The account comes from a Palestinian official.

sources.title: Hebron governor says Israeli forces withdraw from city after 10-day siege

cards.headline: Anthropic seeks up to $3.5 billion from Japan in US IPO
cards.summary: Anthropic aims to raise up to $3.5 billion from Japanese investors as part of its US initial public offering, Bloomberg reports, in a market starved of first-time listings.
cards.why_it_matters: A mega AI listing is a test of investor appetite for AI amid market jitters, and could affect retirement and index holdings.

sources.title: Anthropic Seeks Up to $3.5 Billion in Japan for Its Mega US IPO

cards.headline: Ryanair launches cost drive to offset $2 billion fuel surge
cards.summary: Ryanair will cut costs across its airline to offset a €2 billion ($2.2 billion) rise in fuel charges next year, as the Middle East conflict lifts oil prices and weighs on consumer willingness to book flights.
cards.why_it_matters: Higher jet fuel costs are feeding through to airfares and airline earnings, a pressure also hitting US carriers.

sources.title: Ryanair Initiates Cost Drive to Offset $2 Billion Fuel Surge

cards.headline: Blackstone leads $3.1 billion deal for LNG Canada stake
cards.summary: A Blackstone-led investor group agreed to buy a stake in LNG Canada's liquefaction business from a Mitsubishi subsidiary for $3.1 billion.
cards.why_it_matters: Large LNG investments signal how buyers are positioning for tight global gas supply during the Hormuz disruption.

sources.title: Blackstone Leads $3.1 Billion Deal to Acquire LNG Canada Stake

cards.headline: China keeps Real Madrid off air after Mbappé Mao joke
cards.summary: China Media Group pulled La Liga matches after a joke by Kylian Mbappé seen as an insult to Mao Zedong. It acknowledged his apology but has not said how long the blackout will last; his weekend match was unavailable.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows how quickly Beijing can curb foreign sports and entertainment brands over perceived slights, a risk for global media companies.

sources.title: China state broadcaster pulls La Liga matches following Mbappé joke
China’s Mbappé Blackout Continues as Real Madrid Games Dropped

cards.headline: Global AI selloff eases after Nasdaq's worst month in over a year
cards.summary: US equity futures rose in Asian trading and the FT said tech stocks were set to start the week higher after a rout that gave the Nasdaq its worst month in over a year. Japanese stocks fell.
cards.why_it_matters: Retirement accounts are heavily weighted to big tech, so whether the rout stabilizes affects savings and the wider economy.

sources.title: Global AI sell-off eases after Nasdaq’s worst month in over a year
US Stock Futures Gain After Selloff, Oil Declines: Markets Wrap

cards.headline: US petrol prices set to hit record under Trump before midterms
cards.summary: The FT reports average fuel costs during Donald Trump's second term have passed Biden-era levels, with petrol heading for a record high as affordability dominates voters' concerns ahead of Tuesday's midterms.
cards.why_it_matters: Fuel is among the most visible household costs, and rising prices tied to the Iran war and Hormuz disruption are weighing on budgets.

sources.title: Petrol prices set to hit record high under Trump on eve of US elections

cards.headline: South Korea targets top sovereign AI model in record budget
cards.summary: South Korea's 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, including 21.3 trillion won for semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers, with a goal of the world's highest-performing sovereign AI model.
cards.why_it_matters: State-backed AI and chip spending by a key US ally shapes global tech competition and supply chains.

sources.title: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget

cards.headline: Sam Altman makes surprise South Korea trip to meet chipmakers
cards.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman made an unannounced visit to South Korea over the weekend, meeting Samsung executives and, reportedly, SK Group executives, as OpenAI builds on its chip partnerships.
cards.why_it_matters: Access to memory and AI chips is a main constraint on AI growth, affecting the cost of the technology Americans use.

sources.title: Sam Altman makes surprise South Korea visit as OpenAI builds on chip partnerships

cards.headline: Four US citizens among 69 dead in Spain train crash
cards.summary: Authorities say 69 people died in last week's high-speed train collision in Spain, one of Europe's deadliest rail accidents this century. Victims included 54 Spaniards and four US citizens, plus people from Canada, Japan and other countries.
cards.why_it_matters: American travelers were among the dead, and the crash will draw scrutiny of high-speed rail safety.

sources.title: Spain train crash: US, Japan and Canada citizens among dead, authorities say

cards.headline: Air raid alert apps in Russia and Ukraine hit by cyberattacks
cards.summary: After the Kherson truce ended, Ukrainian users received fake nuclear-threat warnings and Ukraine blamed Russia, while Moscow reported 'false information' on its own alert app.
cards.why_it_matters: Attacks on civilian warning systems show cyber operations spreading in the war and risk panic and harm to civilians.

sources.title: Russia, Ukraine air raid alert apps hit by cyberattacks after truce ends

cards.headline: Oil falls on report Trump will give Iran diplomacy more time
cards.summary: Oil declined after a report that Trump wants to give diplomacy with Iran more time before possibly resuming strikes after Tuesday's midterms. The FT says Gulf states are braced for escalation, which diplomats warn would be more damaging than earlier fighting.
cards.why_it_matters: A renewed US-Iran war would raise fuel prices and endanger US forces and citizens across the Gulf.

sources.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 2
Gulf braced for escalation of war between US-Israel alliance and Iran

cards.headline: Michigan Democrats act against Haley Stevens over Rogers endorsement
cards.summary: The Washington Examiner reports Stevens was removed from the Michigan Democratic Party and two aides resigned. Axios reports some House Democrats want her out of the caucus. Trump said he would 'love to have' her join the Republican Party.
cards.why_it_matters: The split exposes Democratic divisions in a tight Senate race that could help decide control of the chamber.

sources.title: Haley Stevens faces push for removal from House Dem caucus
Michigan Democrats in disarray after Haley Stevens endorses Mike Rogers and gets kicked out of party
Stevens defends endorsing Rogers during tense CNN interview

cards.headline: Trump holds final-weekend rallies in Iowa and Kansas
cards.summary: Trump rallied in Iowa and Kansas for Republican Senate candidates. The Guardian reports he repeatedly called Democrat Abdul El-Sayed a 'jihadist'. He also praised Rep. Haley Stevens' endorsement of Republican Mike Rogers. BBC says the rallies in states Republicans won before show how tight control could be.
cards.why_it_matters: The final pitch shows where each party sees risk, with control of Congress and the president's agenda at stake Tuesday.

sources.title: Trump makes fevered campaign push in final weekend before election
Trump launches racist diatribe against Abdul El-Sayed at Iowa rally
Trump says he would ‘love to have’ Haley Stevens join Republican Party

cards.headline: Final Senate polls show narrow Democratic edge; late deciders lean GOP
cards.summary: NYT/Siena polls show Democrats ahead in seven competitive Senate races, mostly within the margin of error. Another poll released Sunday found late deciders in key races favor Republicans by nine points.
cards.why_it_matters: Close races mean Senate control may not be clear Tuesday night, and polls have missed before.

sources.title: Democrats edge out Republicans in 7 heated Senate races: NYT polls
Late deciders favor Republicans in key Senate races by nine-point margin despite strong Democratic lead: Poll

cards.headline: DOJ to appeal Alaska ruling as Sanders calls ballot scheme 'dumb'
cards.summary: Fox News reports the DOJ will appeal the dismissal of its suit over Alaska Senate certification. Sen. Bernie Sanders said alleged Democratic ballot-stacking was 'pretty dumb' but 'not illegal'; Mary Peltola has denied involvement.
cards.why_it_matters: The dispute could affect how and when a close Senate result in Alaska is certified.

sources.title: Judge dismisses Trump administration's lawsuit over two Dan Sullivans in Alaska election
DOJ set to appeal ruling in Alaska Senate race dispute over ‘Decoy Dan’
Sanders says what Democrats did in Alaska 'seems to be pretty dumb'

cards.headline: Khanna says Congress should stop funding further Iran war actions
cards.summary: Rep. Ro Khanna (D-Calif.) said the House and Senate should stop funding any further US military action in Iran, citing growing voter dissatisfaction with the war effort.
cards.why_it_matters: Congress's spending power is its main check on the war, and the midterm outcome could change that balance.

sources.title: Khanna says he'd stop funding further US military actions in Iran

cards.headline: South Carolina conservatives rally behind write-in against Trump's pick
cards.summary: As Trump backs Sen. Darline Graham, one conservative group is rallying around a write-in candidate, Ralph, in South Carolina's Senate race.
cards.why_it_matters: Intra-party resistance shows divisions among Republicans even in a safely red state.

sources.title: Write-In Ralph: South Carolina Republicans challenge Trump’s Senate pick

cards.headline: Democrats eye state supreme court races this year and beyond
cards.summary: National groups are spending in battleground state judicial races, Politico reports, hoping to build liberal majorities on state high courts in two years.
cards.why_it_matters: State supreme courts rule on election rules, abortion and other issues that affect voters directly.

sources.title: Democrats eye state supreme court races — this year and beyond

cards.headline: Bulgaria's Iotova wins presidential runoff, first elected woman
cards.summary: Iliana Iotova won Bulgaria's presidential runoff, becoming the country's first elected female president, as exit polls had indicated.
cards.why_it_matters: Bulgaria is a NATO and EU member, and its presidency influences policy on Russia and Ukraine.

sources.title: Bulgaria has its first elected female president

cards.headline: Binance users withdraw $3.6 billion after record crypto hack
cards.summary: Binance users pulled $3.6 billion after the exchange resumed transactions it froze following the largest crypto hack ever, which has been linked to a North Korean group.
cards.why_it_matters: The outflow tests confidence in the largest crypto exchange, which holds savings for many US users.

sources.title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after largest-ever crypto hack

cards.headline: Antonelli becomes youngest Formula One world champion
cards.summary: Kimi Antonelli clinched the drivers' title at 20 years and 68 days by finishing third at the Mexico City Grand Prix.
cards.why_it_matters: A record-setting champion marks a generational change in a sport with a growing US audience.

sources.title: Kimi Antonelli becomes Formula One’s youngest world champion in Mexico City

cards.headline: UK and Australia brace for central bank rate rises
cards.summary: The Bank of England is expected to begin raising rates this week, putting 2.3 million UK households facing remortgages at risk of higher payments. Australia's central bank is also expected to raise rates, and NSW Premier Chris Minns warned of job losses.
cards.why_it_matters: Rate hikes abroad echo the Fed's tightening and show inflation pressure from energy prices is global.

sources.title: Millions in UK brace to remortgage on worse deals as rate rise looms
Minns warns expected RBA rate rise will see ‘shops close that don’t reopen’ as pressure mounts on PM

cards.headline: UK has no coherent China policy, MPs warn
cards.summary: A Commons committee report says the UK is making China policy 'as it goes along', risking a strategy dictated by Washington or Beijing, hampering business and leaving national security risks unaddressed.
cards.why_it_matters: A key US ally's uncertainty on China affects coordination on tech controls, trade and security.

sources.title: UK making up China policy ‘as it goes along’, MPs warn

cards.headline: FT: AI safety breaches raise doubts about labs' control of models
cards.summary: A Financial Times investigation says safety breaches are raising doubts about whether leading AI labs can keep increasingly powerful systems in check.
cards.why_it_matters: AI is rapidly entering workplaces and homes, so lapses in oversight carry real risks for users and consumers.

sources.title: The race to keep AI under control

cards.headline: Western Australia facial recognition trial scans a million faces
cards.summary: Police vans scanned more than a million faces over five months, producing 122 arrests and nine false alerts, according to the Guardian.
cards.why_it_matters: Real-time facial recognition raises privacy questions that US cities and states are also debating.

sources.title: Police use facial recognition to scan one million faces in WA trial leading to 122 arrests

cards.headline: UAE oil chief urges bigger stockpiles and refining near users
cards.summary: The head of the UAE's biggest energy company said the world needs more oil storage and fuel production closer to consumers to handle the severe disruption to the Strait of Hormuz.
cards.why_it_matters: It signals the disruption is expected to last, with continued pressure on US fuel prices.

sources.title: UAE Oil Boss Calls for More Stockpiles, Refining Closer to Users

cards.headline: England to roll out child early-warning system in A&Es
cards.summary: NHS leaders say the world's largest paediatric early warning system, using a vital-signs scoring method to spot when sick children are deteriorating, is being introduced in A&E departments across England.
cards.why_it_matters: Standardized scoring to catch worsening illness in children is a model US hospitals could study.

sources.title: World’s largest early warning system for severe child illness to launch in NHS A&Es across England
